mapper.select: SELECT CASE bo.reward_type WHEN 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN 'points' THEN 'POINT' END AS benefit_type, CAST(SUM(ubu.reward_amount_krw) AS SIGNED) AS amount FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, ubu.confirmed_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, ubu.confirmed_at) < #{toUtc} GROUP BY bo.reward_type ORDER BY amount DESC, benefit_type ASC

SELECT mc.category_code, mc.category_name, CAST(SUM(ubu.reward_amount_krw) AS SIGNED) AS benefit_amount FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN merchants merchant ON merchant.merchant_id = approval.merchant_id INNER JOIN merchant_categories mc ON mc.merchant_category_id = merchant.merchant_category_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) < #{toUtc} GROUP BY mc.merchant_category_id, mc.category_code, mc.category_name ORDER BY benefit_amount DESC, mc.category_code ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT outcome.rule_id AS benefit_rule_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(MIN(br.rule_name), ''), MIN(bo.offer_name)) AS title, CASE MIN(bo.reward_type) WHEN 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN 'points' THEN 'POINT' END AS benefit_type, CAST(SUM(outcome.applied_reward_value) AS SIGNED) AS used_amount, CAST(SUM(outcome.expected_reward_value) AS SIGNED) AS limit_amount FROM user_benefit_calculation_outcomes outcome INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = outcome.user_card_id INNER JOIN benefit_rules br ON br.rule_id = outcome.rule_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = outcome.offer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.is_active = TRUE AND outcome.reward_unit = 'KRW' AND outcome.usage_date >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01') AND outcome.usage_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND outcome.missed_reward_value > 0 GROUP BY outcome.rule_id ORDER BY SUM(outcome.missed_reward_value) DESC, title ASC

SELECT uc.user_card_id, COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef) AS card_name, NULLIF(cv.image_url, '') AS card_image_url, CAST(COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) AS SIGNED) AS current_performance_amount,
CAST(COALESCE( (SELECT next_tier.minimum_spend_krw FROM card_performance_tiers next_tier WHERE next_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND next_tier.minimum_spend_krw > COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) ORDER BY next_tier.minimum_spend_krw ASC LIMIT 1), (SELECT MAX(last_tier.minimum_spend_krw) FROM card_performance_tiers last_tier WHERE last_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id), cv.representative_spend, 0) AS SIGNED) AS current_tier_target_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT current_tier.tier_number FROM card_performance_tiers current_tier WHERE current_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND current_tier.minimum_spend_krw <= COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) AND (current_tier.maximum_spend_krw IS NULL OR COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) <= current_tier.maximum_spend_krw) ORDER BY current_tier.tier_number DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS current_tier, ( SELECT next_tier.tier_number FROM card_performance_tiers next_tier WHERE next_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND next_tier.minimum_spend_krw > COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) ORDER BY next_tier.minimum_spend_krw ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS next_tier, uc.display_order FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots snapshot ON snapshot.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND snapshot.performance_month = #{yearMonth}
